name: The Shadow Sovereign
description: Cultivate high-tier agents in shadow. Rule through hidden power.

conditions.description: At least 1 worshipper at tier 3 (Divine) or higher
At least 2 worshippers at tier 3 (Divine) or higher

stages.description: Elevate 3 agents to Aspect tier (tier 4). Absolute shadowy dominion.

conditions.description: At least 3 worshippers at tier 4 (Aspect) or higher

prose.setup_to_escalation: One shadow agent rises to divinity. They move through darkness unseen. Your hidden reach extends into realms of silence and secret.
prose.escalation_to_culmination: Two divine servants now work in shadow. Your web of influence spreads through the hidden paths. The Sovereign begins to take shape.
prose.completed: Three Aspect-tier agents serve you from the shadows. The Shadow Sovereign reigns supreme. Your power is the darkness itself—invisible, irresistible.
prose.failed: Your shadow agents are exposed and diminished. The darkness lifts. Your hidden dominion crumbles into the light.
